title: Skerry Light
blurb: You keep the light on a bare rock in the North Atlantic. By day haul the tide nets and set walls, nets and screens to the quarter each dawn forecasts; by night the breakers land, and what the walls cannot turn goes into the tower. When the light goes out, the logbook buys what the next keeper knows.

shots.beat: Day three: screens behind the side tonight's spray will strike
Night seven: the storm comes through the walls
The light goes out: the logbook pays
